name: flow-reel
description: Make narrated, polished reels of a web app's features with flow-reel: plan the story, explore the app, write the script with comments, sounds and effects, compose it, and screen the reel.

interface.shortDescription: Narrated reels of your app's features
interface.longDescription: Turn "show this feature" into a reel worth sharing: plan the story, explore the running app, write a flow-reel script with comments, sounds and effects, compose it into a narrated video, and screen the result honestly.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use flow-reel's reel skill to make a short narrated reel of a feature.
